$comment: Built-in presets, embedded in the exe. A side-car presets.json merges over this by id: matching id replaces, unknown id adds, "disabled": true hides. Ported from EventLogViewer.ps1 (the original PowerShell app); descriptions carry the event-ID collision notes from that script verbatim - they are hard-won and easy to lose.

presets.label: Software Installs
presets.description: MsiInstaller product install/remove

presets.label: Service Changes
presets.description: New service installed or state changed

presets.label: Driver Installs
presets.description: Kernel/file system driver installed (ID 7045 is shared by every new service; filtered here to entries whose Service Type mentions "driver")

presets.label: Startup/Shutdown
presets.description: Boot, clean shutdown, unexpected shutdown, restart reason

presets.label: User Acct Changes
presets.description: Account created, enabled, disabled, deleted, modified

presets.label: Policy Changes
presets.description: System and domain audit policy changed

presets.label: Logon Events
presets.description: Successful/failed logon and logoff

presets.label: Account Lockouts
presets.description: User account locked out after failed logon attempts

presets.label: Group Membership Chg
presets.description: Members added/removed: global, local, universal security groups

presets.label: Kerberos Auth
presets.description: TGT/service-ticket requests, pre-auth failures, credential validation

presets.label: Explicit Credential
presets.description: Logon using explicit credentials (RunAs) - possible lateral movement

presets.label: Special Privileges
presets.description: Admin-equivalent logon - sensitive privileges assigned

presets.label: Scheduled Task Chg
presets.description: Scheduled task created, deleted, enabled, disabled, or updated

presets.label: Audit Log Cleared
presets.description: Security audit log was cleared - investigate immediately

presets.label: PS Script Block Log
presets.description: Logged PowerShell script block text (requires Script Block Logging GPO)

presets.label: Defender Detections
presets.description: Malware detected / remediation action taken

presets.label: App Crashes
presets.description: Application Error and Application Hang (WER)

presets.label: App Hangs
presets.description: Hang detection and Windows Error Reporting follow-up

presets.label: Resource/Memory
presets.description: Low memory / pool exhaustion / profile warnings

presets.label: Disk Errors
presets.description: Bad block, device I/O error, disk reset - IDs 7/11/153 are also reused by unrelated providers (e.g. Hyper-V networking, Kernel-Boot), so this is scoped to the disk drivers specifically

presets.label: Print Jobs
presets.description: Document printed - job, user, printer, pages

presets.label: Print Errors
presets.description: Spooler errors and failed print jobs

presets.label: Spooler Events
presets.description: Print Spooler service crash or restart (IDs 7031/7034 are generic Service Control Manager events shared by every service, filtered here to Spooler by message text)

presets.label: Network Changes
presets.description: NIC connect/disconnect (NDIS)

presets.label: DHCP Events
presets.description: DHCP lease obtained, renewed, or lost

presets.label: DNS Errors
presets.description: DNS name resolution failure and DNS server errors

presets.label: Firewall Changes
presets.description: Firewall rule added, modified, or exception changed

presets.label: RDP Connections
presets.description: RDP session auth and successful connections

presets.label: VPN / Dial-up
presets.description: RAS/VPN connection success or failure

presets.label: AD Replication (All)
presets.description: All Directory Service log entries - replication/health issues (Domain Controllers only)

presets.label: DFS Replication (All)
presets.description: All DFSR entries - SYSVOL/DFS replication issues (Domain Controllers only)

presets.label: DNS Server (All)
presets.description: All DNS Server role entries (Domain Controllers/DNS role only)

presets.label: Hardware Errors (WHEA)
presets.description: Fatal/corrected hardware errors via WHEA - ID 1 alone is one of the most-reused IDs in the System log, so this is scoped to the WHEA providers specifically

presets.label: Device Install/Removal
presets.description: Device driver install/removal lifecycle - tip: use Keyword box to filter by device type (e.g. "USB")

presets.label: Unexpected Shutdown
presets.description: Kernel-Power: system rebooted without a clean shutdown - often power/hardware related

presets.label: BSOD / Bugcheck
presets.description: Windows Stop Error (blue screen) - bugcheck code and parameters
